latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor Background Changer 1.0.0:

- Instantly replace video backgrounds using a simple description — no editing software or green screen required.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; delivers 1080p MP4 edits in 30–90 seconds.
- Seamless first-time setup: auto-connects, handles anonymous authentication, session management, and credits.
- Simple commands for background replacement, exporting, checking status, and balance.
- All rendering and background processing happens in the cloud with built-in error/status handling.
- Customizable for content creators, presenters, and YouTubers who want fast, high-quality results.
